story = {}
story['start'] = {}
story['start']['narrative'] = "It was a dark and stormy night..."
story['start']['next'] = ['forest', 'diner']

room = 'start'

print(story[room]['narrative'])
print("Where to next? {}".format(story[room]['next']))
